records.title: OWQ: Outlier-Aware Weight Quantization for Efficient Fine-Tuning and Inference of Large Language Models
records.reason: LLM推論時footprintを減らすoutlier-aware weight quantization。量子化に敏感な少数columnだけ高精度で保持し残りを低bit化し、3.1-bitで4-bit OPTQ相当品質を示すため直接対象。
records.body_check: fulltext_relevance_review: 一次論文内容を確認。activation outlierに対応するHessian diagonalからquantization-sensitive weak columnsを同定しFP16保持、残りdense weightsを低bit化。OPT/LLaMAで3.01/3.1-bit OWQが4-bit OPTQに近いperplexityを達成し、inference memory footprint削減を目的化。
